name: smart-email-generator-root
description: Root scripts to run frontend and backend of Smart Email Generator 2 concurrently

scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.start: npx concurrently --kill-others "cd backend && venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
